binding: The full text below is in English; the English version is the binding one.

short.ids: Mewvo works with Discord IDs (the numbers that identify accounts, servers and channels). Where a record needs a readable name, such as a moderation case, the username at that moment is saved with it.
short.messages: The text of your messages is never stored. Technical logs keep only message IDs and lengths.
short.database: Everything is kept in a PostgreSQL database used only by the bot.
short.noEmail: The bot never asks for your email address, a password or payment details. A Mewvo account on this website never asks for an email address either: only if you choose to create one, Mewvo stores a username and a one-way hash of your password (see below).
short.noTracking: This website has no analytics, no ads, no tracking and no third-party scripts or cookies.

short.age: You can use the bot if you are allowed to use Discord (at least 13, or older where the law of your country says so) and follow Discord’s rules.
short.rules: Follow the rules of the server you are in. Don’t use Mewvo to harass anyone, to spam, to share illegal content or to get around a punishment.
short.staffDecide: Server staff decide warnings, mutes, kicks and bans in their server; Mewvo carries them out. Every punishment can be reviewed by a person, and the DM about it says whether and how you can appeal.
short.payments: No payments are taken yet: the checkout on this website is a test and nobody is charged. A plan does not renew by itself.
short.withdrawal: When you buy a paid plan, you can withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason.
short.law: Lithuanian law applies, but as a consumer you keep the protection of the mandatory law of the country where you live.
